text:
Alex R.: hey team — first week! quick q: where do i post different things so i don't spam channels? access requests, laptop/help, calendar/time-off, lunch plans, and deploy noise? also how do i mute noisy bots without missing important pings?

Taylor (IT): welcome! short version: use threads to keep channels tidy. specific rules: #help for access/account issues, #eng-infra for infra/GPU/node problems, #support for billing/customer-facing stuff, #new-hires for onboarding Qs, #random for social/lunch. For deploy/alert noise use #eng-releases or #release-war-room.

Taylor (IT): etiquette tips: 
- start related follow-ups as a thread on the root message (don’t DM the channel).
- react with :white_check_mark: or :eyes: for quick ack instead of replying “thanks”.
- only use @here/@channel for urgent-site-impact ops.

Maya Chen: hi Alex — welcome! ppl-ops prefers hardware/access requests in #help and filling the hardware form in the onboarding doc: https://redwood.com/docs/onboarding/channel-map — includes who-to-ask matrix (IT, security, manager). Also set your timezone in your profile so calendar invites look right.

Samir Patel: about noisy bots — you can mute a channel (click channel name > Muted) or fine-tune notifications: "Notification preferences > Mentions & reactions" and turn off "All new messages" but keep "Replies to threads you're in". For the most common things I do: 
```
/remind me in 2 hours to submit badge
/invite @Taylor
```
The reminders and invites are handy.

Jonah K: for oncall/alerts: if something looks like a real incident, reply in-thread and ping #eng-oncall, add :rotating_light: so people know to escalate. Avoid DM-only unless you need a private escalation.

onboard-bot: Checklist update: 
- [x] account created
- [ ] laptop assigned
- [ ] manager intro scheduled
- [ ] access to prod (request in #help)
(see https://redwood.com/internal/onboarding-checklist)

Alex R.: perfect, this helps a ton. i'll post hardware request in #help and keep lunch invites to #random. thanks everyone :raised_hands: 

Samir Patel: quick pro-tip — turn off thread previews if you want less noise (Profile > Preferences > Messages & media).

Taylor (IT): if anything blocks you ping me or @IT-Team. also add yourself to #new-hires and opt into the onboarding bot by clicking the join message. :wave:
